item.title: Version 1.0.16
item.description:
Nomad mode is now strict.

When you pick Nomad and tap FLIP, your iPhone shows exactly 11 apps and nothing else:
Phone, Messages, FaceTime, Camera, Photos, Maps, Notes, Calendar, Music, Safari, Settings.

Previously Nomad was using a hardcoded list of ~37 Apple apps (Books, Stocks, News, Translate, etc.) regardless of what your Nomad profile specified. Now the profile's bundle list is the literal allow list — Music gets through because we put it there, Calculator hides because we didn't.

Settings stays as your escape hatch (VPN & Device Management lives there if you ever need to remove Flipped's supervision).
